scope: Base EP 3038247973 only; exact five official-eligibility rows. Research contract, not a production resource.

damageSymbols.B: Original full nonprecision direct-hit damage before shot-distance falloff, for the applicable weapon and target.
damageSymbols.M: Original precision multiplier; M=1 for a body hit.
damageSymbols.F: Existing shot-distance impact damage multiplier; its EP-specific application is not independently verified here.

verified.trigger: On projectile impact/contact; AoE damages enemies near impact, not merely near the in-flight shot.
verified.baseReloadBonus: No sourced reload bonus for base EP. DDC arrow +5 reload belongs to excluded enhanced EP 64866129.

notEstablishedByInspectedSources.noShotDistanceFalloffForExplosion: Provisional parent policy; neither inspected DDC EP row nor current original Clarity EP record explicitly mentions it. Do not attribute this clause to DDC.
notEstablishedByInspectedSources.explosionRadialDamageFalloff: Unknown. 3m maximum radius is not proof of uniform damage or linear radial attenuation.
notEstablishedByInspectedSources.friendlyFireSelfDamageProtection: Enemies-only DDC wording supports hostile selection; precise friend/PvP/protected/self edge cases and native contact through a denied target are not established.
notEstablishedByInspectedSources.engineOrdering: Native callback/event order, impact transaction ordering and exact immunity behavior not measured.
notEstablishedByInspectedSources.staggerTiers: Qualitative increased PvE stagger only. No numeric tier, poise damage, duration, threshold, guaranteed interrupt, immunity bypass or Champion stun supplied.

requestedLocalContract.weaponFinalBlowTokenRouting: Allow ordinary weapon-kill credit through positive original shot ownership, subject to legal socket coexistence and existing target protections.
requestedLocalContract.worldContact: Parent must resolve actual native contact point for nearby blast, independently of whether a direct target took damage; Minecraft callback wiring is local.
requestedLocalContract.parentReportedLocalGeometry: Parent reports .25 radial policy, nearest-AABB-point distance, LOS and cap. No Destiny measurement inferred.

historicalBoundary: Bungie March/April 2024 Crucible hand-cannon changes are historical and separately cached. They do not supply current selected scout/sniper precision constants or a new EP split.
